title: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one 💰
subject: gta6
description:
Did you buy it on launch day? 👇

Take-Two says GTA 6 reached $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales on its first day, the biggest entertainment launch in history, after 32.5 million copies were sold before release. GTA 6 is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Take-Two Interactive press release (Nov 20, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 20, 2026), esports.gg
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion in a single day.
Take-Two announced the number on November 20. It counts worldwide retail sales through the end of launch day, November 19.
Before the game even unlocked, 32.5 million copies were already sold, another record across every platform.
For comparison, GTA 5 needed three days to pass $1 billion back in 2013.
Take-Two calls it the biggest entertainment launch in history, in any medium. Sam Houser says Rockstar is incredibly humbled by the response.
